description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class that manages CRUD operations for 'Answer' objects associated with questions in a Q&A application.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: REST controller for handling answer-related HTTP requests, including retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting answers linked to questions.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of answers for a specific question identified by questionId.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new answer to a specific question identified by questionId.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing answer identified by answerId for the specified questionId.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an answer identified by answerId for the specified questionId.
